newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-PIOLINE TO MEET ULIHRACH IN CZECH OPEN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-PIOLINE TO MEET ULIHRACH IN CZECH OPEN FINAL.

text.p: France's Cedric Pioline fought off Spain's Emilio Alvarez 6-3 6-7 6-1 on Saturday to reach the final of the $365,000 Czech Open.
In Sunday's final, the fourth seeded Frenchman will face third seed Czech Bohdan Ulihrach who had little trouble in dismissing an out-of-sorts Fabrice Santoro 6-4 6-2 in the other semifinal.
Pioline, who had never faced Alvarez before, took control of the match early, twice breaking the Spaniard in the first set.
Pioline squandered several chances in the second set, failing to capitalise on three match points before succumbing 9-7 in a tiebreak.
But the 24-year-old Alvarez, ranked 89 in the world, tired in the third set, committing a slew of unforced errors.
"In the second set he played with more energy, more aggressively, but it looked like he tired in the third set and I just kept trying to force the play," Pioline said.
Santoro, France's other semifinalist, failed to show Friday's form when he upset second seed Chilean Marcelo Rios.
Ulihrach, ranked 23 in the world, kept Santoro on the run for most of the match, blistering winner after winner past the ragged-looking Frenchman.
